statement: Whenever update_matrix(mat) returns a result r, r has dimensions m by n (len(r) = m and len(r[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < m), and for every cell (i,j) with 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, r[i][j] equals the integer minimum of the set { |i-a| + |j-b| : 0 <= a < m, 0 <= b < n, mat[a][b] = 0 }.
